subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should per-response `/usage` show active-provider quota windows, and if so which existing `/usage` modes may consume a lifecycle-owned cached snapshot rather than perform a provider lookup during reply delivery?
rationale: The feature is useful but changes the reply hot path and user-visible footer contract; the closed implementation attempts do not establish a maintainer-approved refresh, latency, and failure policy.

options.title: Approve cached quota summaries
options.body: Add a generic snapshot seam and show formatted windows in the selected existing `/usage` modes, with provider lookup owned outside reply delivery.

options.title: Keep quota in `/status`
options.body: Retain the current on-demand status surface and avoid adding provider quota information to every response footer.

options.title: Defer to a broader footer design
options.body: Handle this together with a maintainer-approved generic response-footer product direction rather than adding a narrow usage-only behavior now.

recommendation.title: Approve cached quota summaries
recommendation.body: Add a generic snapshot seam and show formatted windows in the selected existing `/usage` modes, with provider lookup owned outside reply delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The provider-usage/status history and existing maintainer analysis place this product and lifecycle boundary closest to their recent work.
